description: This Swift file defines a utility function 'makeWakeWordSegments' that processes a transcript and a list of words with associated timestamps to generate WakeWordSegment instances, capturing text segmentation within the transcript.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of a wake word within a transcript, including text, start time, duration, and text range.

methods.name: makeWakeWordSegments
methods.description: Creates a list of WakeWordSegment objects from a transcript and a list of words with timestamps, mapping each word to its position within the transcript.
